title: Default test run at yooukqwllnmu
description: The default test run (python3 lib/tools/test_costs.py run: cargo test and every Python suite, the unit and tool tiers) at change yooukqwllnmu, "The default test run is a verification job nobody waits for, only the newest of those waiting runs, the watcher triages ", queued to check the job end to end, in the workspace prove-setup. Nobody waits for it: the watcher or the next session reads the result, and sync.py push requires a passed run that covers the commit it pushes (verification/default_tests.py).
expected: exits 0: every test of the default run passes

resources.notes: the default run took about 16 minutes inline in 2026-11 (11 Rust, 5 Python), longer beside proof jobs; its cargo target directory is kept warm between runs
